items.title: SteamLite 26.11.6
items.text: Optimised animations, and smooth scrolling for the mouse wheel.
features: Tabs you can grab and drag, with the page following them
A Play, Stop and Cancel button that changes shape
Lighter animations while a game is running

items.title: SteamLite 26.12
items.text: A quality-of-life release: a faster start, and a lot of small things that get in your way less. It goes straight to stable, with no beta.
features: Your library appears at once, then updates from Steam
Steam not running: SteamLite starts it and launches your game when it is ready
Remembers your page, sort, filter and window position
Download and update progress on your games
Disk usage, a Largest first sort, and soundtracks, demos and tools hidden by default
Select several games with Ctrl or Shift, and Undo for hide and delete
Close to the tray, start minimised, and an option to pause SteamLite while you play

items.title: SteamLite for Linux (preview)
items.text: SteamLite on Linux, built and tested on Ubuntu first. It runs today in testing, and it is planned as a preview on 1 December, alongside 26.12.
features: Finds your Steam library and starts games through Steam
Install it from a .deb, with an AppImage where it can be made
items.note: This is a preview: Linux is tested on Ubuntu first, and updates inside the app come later. If it is not ready on the 1st, the date will move and we will say so here.

items.title: SteamLite 27.1 Beta, "Graphine"
items.text: Graphine is the nickname for 27.1: a lighter, faster SteamLite that uses less memory and less of your PC while a game is running.
items.note: If it is not ready on the 15th, the date will move and we will say so here.
